_comment: TEMPLATE, do not edit by hand. Run BOOTSTRAP-PROMPT.md with your agent + the ApparelHub connector; it reads your account's readiness and writes a real state.json next to this file. Then run KICKOFF-PROMPT.md.
_never_store: No token, API key, password, or secret is ever written to this file, not even masked or truncated. Credentials go straight to the connect tool and are then forgotten.
_source_of_truth: check_setup_readiness is authoritative. This file only records what the operator has already been told, so a fresh session can resume without re-asking. If the two disagree, believe readiness.

sales_channel._skipped_note: true means the operator chose fulfillment-only for now. That is a valid finished state, not an unfinished one.

blocked._note: Set when a plan limit stops a phase. A limit is an outcome to report plainly, not an error to retry.
